next.reason: 1985: 'Any move that is not an elementary move is treated exactly as if it were an alphanumeric to alphanumeric elementary move'; 2023: 'Any move that is not an elementary move, and does not reference a variable-length group, is treated exactly as if'. 2023 drops the alphanumeric-move treatment for variable-length groups (incl. occurs-depending); GR 9 moves corresponding tables separately and space-fills excess.
